backend/main.mo: Motoko actor managing countdown timers with create, read, update, delete, pause, resume, and completion operations stored in a Map.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping UI/navigation feature IDs to affected frontend files and related components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend source files for documentation or planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base layer defining light and dark theme CSS variables and applying global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up dark mode from localStorage before loading the React app.
frontend/public/study-planner-mockup.htm: Standalone static HTML mockup demonstrating the Study Planner UI using inline styles and CDN React.
frontend/src/App.tsx: React app entry configuring the TanStack Router with routes for core pages and wrapping them in Layout and AppErrorBoundary.
frontend/src/components/AddChapterDialog: Dialog component allowing users to input and submit new chapter details for a subject.
frontend/src/components/AllChaptersBySub: Lists chapters grouped by subject and displays them by status with counts and icons.
frontend/src/components/AnimatedIcon.tsx: Wraps a Lucide icon with optional active animation and configurable size.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary that shows error details and offers navigation, reload, and data reset options.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavigation: Fixed bottom navigation bar that renders the SubjectsBar component.
frontend/src/components/ChapterCard.tsx: Displays chapter info, status, and a timer with controls for working sessions and deletion.
frontend/src/components/ChapterDetailPan: Slide-out panel for editing chapter details, status, and target hours with validation and updates.
frontend/src/components/DashboardComplet: Shows a per-subject completion percentage chart using bar-style progress visuals.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout with header, page transitions, customization panel, footer navigation, and routing outlet.
frontend/src/components/MonthGridCalenda: Renders a month grid calendar with navigation and selectable days, including indicators for entries. Computes month layout using date math and fills previous/next month cells.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsSec: Displays notifications for incomplete chapters, todos, and today's calendar entries. Aggregates data from multiple hooks and shows counts with badges.
frontend/src/components/OverallPerforman: Builds a performance trend chart using test scores, computes linear regression for trend, and renders an SVG line graph. Shows average percentage and trend indicators.
frontend/src/components/PageTransition.t: Adds a fade transition between route changes by tracking pathname changes. Wraps children in an animated container.
Manages and displays subject resources with add and delete actions. Provides a form to add resources and a list with delete buttons.
frontend/src/components/ShareAppLinkDial: Provides a dialog to share the app link with copy-to-clipboard support. Shows the current URL and a button to open it in a new tab.
frontend/src/components/SubjectCompletio: Visualizes subject chapter completion progress with a bar and chapter grid. Tracks newly completed chapters to animate changes.
frontend/src/components/SubjectDeleteBut: Renders a delete button with confirmation dialog and triggers callbacks plus a toast when a subject is deleted.
frontend/src/components/SubjectsBar.tsx: Displays a horizontal subjects list with navigation, add-subject dialog, and delete-subject confirmation logic.
frontend/src/components/SubjectsSelector: Provides a popover-based subject picker with inline subject creation and navigation to selected subjects.
frontend/src/components/TasksDrawer.tsx: Implements a slide-out menu with navigation links and a tasks panel for managing todos by subject.
frontend/src/components/TestScoreChart.t: Renders a responsive SVG line or bar chart visualizing test scores with scaling and labeled grid lines.
frontend/src/components/TodoList.tsx: Shows a subject-specific todo list with task creation, completion toggling, and deletion.
frontend/src/customization/applyDarkMode: Applies light or dark mode to the document root based on override settings.
frontend/src/customization/Customization: Simple icon button that triggers opening customization settings.
UI panel component that displays and updates customization settings such as theme, target hours, and other study preferences.
Context provider managing customization settings, syncing updates, and applying dark mode overrides.
frontend/src/customization/integration.t: Utility functions for notifications, sleep window checks, chapter card density, and study time calculations.
frontend/src/customization/settingsModel: Defines customization settings schema, defaults, and validation logic.
frontend/src/customization/useCustomizat: Hook for loading, saving, applying, and deleting user-defined customization presets in localStorage.
Hook managing persistent customization settings with load, update, and reset behavior.
frontend/src/data/chapters.ts: Defines chapter model and provides the initial list of chapters across subjects.
frontend/src/data/subjects.ts: Defines subjects, maps their icons, and provides legacy route and name mappings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCalendarEntries.ts: Hook for CRUD operations on calendar entries persisted in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useChapterData.ts: Manages chapter list state with localStorage persistence, syncing across tabs, and functions to update, add, and delete chapters.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTarget.ts: Loads, validates, and stores a single countdown target date with setter logic.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTimer.ts: Computes live time remaining until a target date, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdownTimers.ts: Handles multiple countdown timers with migration, validation, selection logic, and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentlyWorkingCh: Tracks active and paused chapter work sessions with timers, persistence, migration, and cross‑tab sync.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardInside.ts: Stores and retrieves a simple dashboard content string in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardNote.ts: Stores and manages a dashboard note string with versioned localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardTitle.ts: Loads and saves a dashboard title string with default fallback.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, clearing, status tracking, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useNotes.ts: Manages a list of notes with CRUD operations and localStorage persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook exposing actor and fetching state for future backend queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useResources.ts: Manages subject-specific study resources with localStorage persistence and migration from legacy formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyLog.ts: Tracks study log entries, persists them, and triggers sleep‑window warnings based on customization settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubjectDetails.ts: Stores and updates per‑subject metadata like target hours and finish dates using versioned localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useSubjects.ts: Loads, migrates, and manages the list of subjects with add/delete operations and localStorage sync.
frontend/src/hooks/useTests.ts: Handles creation and editing of tests and their score histories, persisting all data in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodos.ts: Manages subject‑specific todos with legacy migration and writes merged updates back to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useTodosAll.ts: Provides a global view of all todos and keeps them synced via storage events and polling.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers and custom light/dark theme color variables for the app's UI styling.
frontend/src/lib/appLocalStorage.ts: Defines all app-specific localStorage keys and provides helpers to clear them and retrieve the full key list.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a utility function that merges class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/CalendarDashboard.tsx: Implements a calendar dashboard with a month grid and per-day work item CRUD operations.
frontend/src/pages/CountdownTimer.manual: Manual test checklist covering creation, selection, editing, deletion, persistence, and edge cases for countdown timers.
frontend/src/pages/CountdownTimer.tsx: Provides UI and logic for managing multiple countdown timers, including creating, selecting, renaming, deleting, and setting target times.
frontend/src/pages/Customize.tsx: Implements the customization page for editing UI settings, managing presets, and adding or deleting subjects.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main dashboard with stats, editable title and notes, active chapter tracking, and completion metrics.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: React page for creating, editing, selecting, and deleting notes with form handling and toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectPage.tsx: Subject detail page managing chapters, subject metadata, timers, and editing actions with multiple UI panels.
frontend/src/pages/Tests.tsx: Page for managing tests, including creating tests, editing them, adding scores, and rendering performance charts.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending theme colors, fonts, breakpoints, and enabling plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking features, requests, versions, and current state for navigation UI restructuring.
